bio: This former coaching inn run by Yohann Giraud, a chef who has worked in several Michelin-starred restaurants, has a pleasantly hushed atmosphere. On the menu: dishes bursting with flavour, such as the signature macaroni stuffed with foie gras, celeriac and tartufata au gratin with parmesan, cream and a veal jus, or the oh-so-delicate millefeuille with a caramel sauce. The charming service completes the picture....
